description: Checkout's one downstream Relationship edge (checkout -> fulfillment, scenario 6's relationship-target-change seed) is real and traversable but has confidence exactly 0.5 (a single standing source, trace-index). A scripted minimumConfidence of 0.6 correctly excludes it, proving a real but weakly evidenced path is excluded at the scripted floor (ADR-0035 § 3) rather than merely absent as in the zero-impact scenario.
